purpose: A fixed daily observation-context case, not a fitted correction
selection_reason: Fixed one-degree southern Kalimantan rectangle within the established September 2019 regional case; not selected for the resulting cloud or fire counts.
sample: All native sinusoidal grid-cell centres within the rectangle, same cells each date. No resampling or threshold-based region selection.
metrics: Daily counts of all ten FireMask classes; exhaustive partition of the fixed grid. Fire classes 7, 8 and 9 retained separately.
guardrails: Do not infer clear-sky overpass counts from daily composites
Do not divide FIRMS cell-days by a different product's observed fraction
Do not treat a non-fire classification as proof of no fire
Do not apply this local historical case to the current Kalimantan comparison
Same MODIS instrument: observation context, not independent fire validation
